mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ddh_component_discovery_result WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} ORDER BY discovery_start_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ddh_component_discovery_result SET discovery_status = #{discoveryStatus}, discovery_end_time = #{discoveryEndTime}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_ddh_component_discovery_result SET discovery_stats = #{discoveryStats}, discovery_details = #{discoveryDetails}, registered_count = #{registeredCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_ddh_component_discovery_result WHERE discovery_start_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysToKeep} DAY)
